_comment: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and add your OpenRouter key. Set a per-key spend limit in OpenRouter and rotate the key after the prank.
_provider: OpenRouter (OpenAI-compatible). base_url + model IDs are OpenRouter's, not Anthropic's.
_model_help: Pick from https://openrouter.ai/models (or switch in game with F10 - that choice is remembered). Per million tokens in/out: fable-5 $10/$50, opus-5 $5/$25, sonnet-5 $2/$10. The sidecar checks the id with OpenRouter at startup.
title: DDLC Director Mod
_ddlc_help: The sidecar finds DDLC by itself and installs the bridge into it on every start. Only if it can't: set ddlc_game_dir to your DDLC folder, e.g. C:/Users/you/Downloads/ddlc-win/DDLC-1.1.1-pc
